Frontend UI verified working - login, dashboard, appointments with Pay Deposit, settings with Integrations (Stripe Active + Calendar Connect), payment success/cancel pages.

Called get_available_slots(start_date=, end_date=) with wrong signature - actual signature is get_available_slots(date, barber_id, duration_minutes)
fixed.fix: Changed to iterate over days and call get_available_slots(date=current_day, barber_id=barber_id) for each day

fixed.issue: CreateWaitlistRequest missing preferred_barber_id and notes fields used by routes

fixed.issue: CreateClientRequest missing notes field used by routes/clients.py
